I replied to Dana in your DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

That number comes from Dana's own posts in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025. She first wrote 180, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. She also said the amendment was signed the day before, 19 Aug.

I couldn't find the amendment document in the shared files, so I can't check the number against the signed copy. I told Dana to ask June Osei-Lark if the deck needs the document as its source, since Dana sent her the signed copy. A seat count is an operational fact, so no approval was needed to share it.
